description:
Maximo Moto is one of the leading motorcycle stores in the UK. We have a large motorcycle clothing and gear store in the West Midlands. We also have a solid presence in the Western Europe including 14 stores in Spain, 3 stores in Italy, and one store in Portugal. Start with the peace of mind that you are working with an established and growing brand. 

Work with an established brand to maximise your chances of success. Maximo Moto started in February, 2021. We sell merchandise from the leading brands; brands that your audience already trusts. 

If you are a social media influencer, a people person, a niche site owner, or a techie with a price comparison website or a browser extension, we would love to work with you. 

Affiliate commission starts at 5% for all products except helmets. We offer 8% commission on all helmets. 

Earn more as you refer more customers to Maximo Moto. Get as much as 10% of the sales you make when you bring in GBP 5000 or more.

The cookie duration is 30 days. Payment threshold is GBP 100. We make all eligible payments monthly through PayPal and direct bank transfers. The commission for an affiliate sale is credited to the affiliate account 60 days after the date of purchase. 

Get all the marketing material ready for promotion including social media banners, HTML banners, product feeds, landing pages, sales emails, and more. You can also request promotional materials and our dedicated affiliate program team will make that asset available. 

Start making money with our affiliate program. Join Today.

Maximo Moto Affiliate Terms and Conditions

Your participation in the Affiliate Program is conditioned on your acceptance of these Terms of Service and all terms, conditions, and notices contained herein. Please read the Terms of Service carefully. If you do not want to agree to these Terms of Service, you must not participate in the Affiliate Program.

1. Eligibility for the Affiliate Program

To participate in the Affiliate Program, you must submit an application through Maximo Moto’s Affiliate Signup, available at
https://maximomoto.co.uk/pages/affiliate-registration . Maximo Moto reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to accept or reject any application for membership in the Affiliate Program for any reason. Affiliates must be at least 18 years old in order to participate in the Affiliate Program.

2. Referrals

You will receive a commission for Qualified Referrals to Maximo Moto. The percentage of the commission may change at any time and without notice. “Qualified Referrals” mean customers referred by you to Maximo Moto who:

  1. click on your unique tracking link within thirty (30) days of clicking on your unique tracking link, successfully
    purchased.
  2. Doesn’t return the product within 30 days of purchase.
    Affiliates who share the same personal/company details, including but not limited to, last name, email address, IP address, website details, or commission payment
    details, as their referred customer will be deemed to have made a “Self-Referral.” Referral commission and any earnings associated with this type of “Self-Referral”
    will not be paid. Maximo Moto, in its sole discretion, will determine the classification of any referral as a “Self-Referral.”

3. Commissions

  1. Commissions earned on referrals become payable 45 days after the referred customer becomes a Qualified Referral.
  2. Your total commission amount must equal or exceed one hundred GBP100 Great British Pounds before receiving a payment from Maximo Moto.
  3. If your total commissions for a given month are less than GBP100, payment will be held until the total commissions equal or exceed GBP100.
  4. If at any time a Qualified Referral files a credit card dispute, any earned Affiliate commission on the disputed charge shall become frozen in your account until the dispute is settled. You will not receive any interest on commissions that have been
    frozen.
  5. If the dispute is settled in Maximo Moto’s favor, any associated earned Affiliate commission will become payable to you.
  6. If the dispute is settled in the Qualified Referral’s favor, any associated earned Affiliate commission shall not be paid to you. 
  7. If commissions have already been paid out to you, the amount of
    earned commissions on the disputed charges shall be debited to your account. 
  8. Commission payments will be paid in GBP and may be made via electronic payment (such as Paypal), bank transfer, or cheque.
  9. You are responsible for paying all applicable fees associated with accepting payments, including but not limited to, currency conversion fees, transaction fees, withdrawal fees, deposit fees, etc.
  10. Commission payment will be made only after the proper invoice is issued.
  11. Maximo Moto reserves the right to request documentation in order to approve your account. These requests may be made during the Affiliate Program application process or at any time while you have an active account in the Affiliate Program.
  12. If requests for documentation are not responded to in a timely manner, Maximo Moto reserves the right to terminate, deactivate, or not approve your account.

4. Marketing

You shall bear your own costs and expenses related to marketing and promoting Maximo Moto and/or the Affiliate Program. Maximo Moto is not obligated to reimburse or credit you for any marketing expenses. If Maximo Moto does reimburse you for any marketing expenses, such reimbursement shall not create a
duty or obligation to reimburse any future marketing expenses.

You may not engage in any of the following marketing activities and represent and warrant that your marketing practices do not violate any of these restrictions:

  1. Affiliates shall not make any false, misleading, or disparaging statements with respect to the Affiliate Program, Maximo Moto, its employees, its customers, its Services, or its Affiliates.
  2. Affiliates shall not create websites or advertisements that copy, imitate, or resemble the look and feel of Maximo Moto’s Services.
  3. Affiliates shall not copy Maximo Moto’s website or any portions thereof, including, without limitation, any of Maximo Moto’s trademarks or other intellectual property, and display them on their own site or subdomain or use them in any way without Maximo Moto’s prior express written consent.
  4. Affiliates shall not offer cashback, coupons, rewards, or other incentives as part of their marketing efforts for the Affiliate Program.
  5. Affiliates shall not use traffic that is generated by, including, but not limited to, pay to click, pay to read, banner exchanges, click exchanges, cost-per-view advertising, pop-up/under, spam, purchased traffic, or similar methods without prior written consent from Maximo Moto.
  6. Affiliates shall not use cookie stuffing techniques that set the tracking cookie without the potential customer actually clicking on the Affiliate’s referral link.
  7. Affiliates are responsible for ensuring their tracking codes are working properly before sending traffic to Maximo Moto’s servers. Any modification to the links is the sole responsibility of the
  8. Affiliate. Referral fees may be withheld, as determined in Maximo Moto’s sole discretion, for tracking errors caused by editing, masking, redirecting, or tampering with affiliate links.
  9. Affiliates shall not bid on or use Maximo Moto’s trademarks or misspelled keywords for the purpose of pay-per-click on internet search engines without prior written consent from Maximo Moto.
  10. Affiliates shall not use Maximo Moto’s trademarks or misspelled keywords in their domain names. 
  11. Affiliates shall not use redirected pages and links to send a potential customer to Maximo Moto’s website.
  12. Affiliates shall not engage in domain forwarding (i.e. purchasing a domain and setting it to forward directly to Maximo Moto’s website using an affiliate link).
  13. Affiliates shall not engage in the advertisement of business-opportunity websites or use marketing practices that attract fraudulent or short-term customers.
  14. Affiliates shall not engage in any marketing activity that may harm the reputation or credibility of Maximo Moto, including using low-quality marketing materials, or advertising on any website that promotes violence, discrimination based on race, sex, religion, nationality, disability, sexual orientation or age, or any illegal activities, or violates the intellectual property or other rights of a third party.
  15. Affiliates shall not send any email in violation of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
  16. Affiliates must include a physical mailing address and unsubscribe information for any marketing email sent promoting Maximo Moto’s Services.
  17. Affiliates shall make clear that they, not Maximo Moto, are the sender of all marketing communications related to the promotion of Maximo Moto’s
    Services.
  18. Affiliates shall not engage in any marketing or promotional activities that violate applicable laws, rules, or regulations.
  19. Affiliates shall not market using facsimile, broadcast, telemarketing, text message marketing, or other offline marketing methods regarding Maximo Moto or Maximo Moto’s Services without the express written consent of Maximo Moto.
  20. Affiliates shall not use malware or spyware to market or promote Maximo Moto’s Services.

5. Termination

Maximo Moto may, in its sole discretion, terminate your participation in the Affiliate Program at any time, with or without cause, and without warning or notice. Without limiting the foregoing, Maximo Moto reserves the right to terminate your
account if it has been inactive for 12 consecutive months.

Maximo Moto reserves the right to terminate your participation in the Affiliate Program and not pay the accrued balance if you have been deemed to breach Maximo Moto’s Terms of Use or these Terms of Service or engage in any conduct that Maximo Moto deems to be illegal, improper, unfair, or otherwise adverse or detrimental to Maximo Moto.

In Maximo Moto’s sole discretion, affiliate accounts generating a large number of fraudulent accounts or that are associated with any false or misleading advertising or suspected fraudulent activity will be deactivated.

You may terminate your participation in the Affiliate Program at any time. You may discontinue your participation in the Affiliate Program by removing your affiliate links from your website and no longer promoting them. For accounting purposes, Maximo Moto’s systems will retain Your account and personal information.

By terminating your participation in the Affiliate Program, you waive your right to be paid any unpaid commissions below the minimum threshold and you assign (by way of future assignment) all of your rights and ownership of any commissions which we are holding to your account.

You will not receive any commissions which are earned after the date of termination. Upon termination, all rights granted to you shall be immediately terminated.

6. Relationship between you and Maximo Moto

Neither these Terms of Service nor your participation in the Affiliate Program creates any employment, independent contractor, agency, partnership, or joint venture relationship between you and Maximo Moto.

7. Non-Disparagement

During the term of these Terms of Service and for one (1) year after it has expired or been terminated, You agree that You will not disparage Maximo Moto, its officers, directors, or employees or otherwise take any action that could reasonably be expected to adversely affect Maximo Moto’s reputation.

Under these Terms of Service, “disparage” includes, but is not limited to, any negative statement, whether written or oral, about Maximo Moto, its officers, directors, or employees.

You agree and acknowledge that this provision is a material term of the Terms of Service, the absence of which would have resulted in Maximo Moto refusing to enter into this agreement.

8. Assumption of Risk

You are solely responsible for ensuring that your participation in the Affiliate Program complies with applicable law and does not violate the rights of any third party, including, without limitation, intellectual property rights.

You assume all liability for any claims, suits, or grievances filed against you, including, but not limited to, all damages related to participation in the Affiliate Program.

9. Remedies for Violations

Maximo Moto reserves the right to seek all remedies available at law and in equity for violations of these Terms of Service.

10. Governing Law and Jurisdiction; Disputes and Arbitration

These Terms of Service are governed by and construed in accordance with the internal law of the United Kingdom without regard to its principles of conflicts of
laws.

11. Changes to the Terms of Service

Maximo Moto may review and update these Terms of Service at any time in our sole discretion and it is your responsibility to keep abreast of those changes. All changes are effective immediately when posted. Your continued participation in the Affiliate
Program following the posting of revised Terms of Service means that you accept and agree to the changes which are binding on you, so please check this webpage
periodically for updates.

12. Contact Us

If you have questions or concerns regarding these Terms of Service or the Affiliate Program,

you may contact us at: affiliate-program@maximomoto.co.uk
